name: mirage
text: Checking it now. What I see so far: SharpAPI's key is accepted and its stream is live, but in the last scan it matched only 11 games against Kalshi's 26, so it is contributing far less than it should. Also its +EV cross-check fails every 10 min because Novig is not among the 25 books picked on your SharpAPI dashboard (harmless; I'm making it stand down). I'm adding per-league logging of what SharpAPI returns so I can see why so few games match, then I'll fix it. v1.0.44 (SharpAPI card + Live switch) is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.44
